name: Adobe Public Bug Bounty

program_type.summary: Monetary bounties are advertised; awards are discretionary.

rewards.summary: Tiers: $150–$15,000, $100–$10,000 and $75–$5,000. Shared-root-cause findings receive one bounty; repeated patterns have a two-report full-bounty cap. Dollar denomination remains unverified, so normalized bounds remain null.

eligibility.summary: First reproducible, previously unknown eligible reports qualify. Employee/immediate-family exclusions last 12 months; specified network-access contractors, six. Platform adulthood/guardian-approved age-16 and legal/employer conditions apply.

restrictions.summary: Product-specific plans override general guidance and constrain environments/accounts. AI-assisted findings need human validation. Privacy violations, disruption, social engineering, unapproved customer environments and premature disclosure are prohibited.

submission_status.summary: Visible policies and login invitations do not verify acceptance.

scope_context.included_summary: Approved AI, creative/document, commerce, mobile, enterprise, identity and supporting web-service categories, subject to listed products and controlling plans.
